nodes.text: Search the path between the upper and lower bridge for Cinderfall, defeat it and loot for Blackflame Daggers. Use Next pin to inspect the other patrol endpoint.

recovery.text: A kill or the daily tracking flag does not establish that this toy dropped or that toy loot is exhausted. Use observed loot eligibility; the drop chance and respawn time remain unknown.

nodes.text: Use Blackflame Daggers from your bags to add it to your Toy Box.

recovery.text: If the reward is missing, inspect the quest reward and your bags. Completing the encounter or quest does not prove the toy was received or learned.
